verdict.rationale: Helicone's first-party Alerts feature monitors error rates and costs on LLM requests. Each alert can be configured with filters and notifies through Slack or email. Alerts are also listed as a paid-plan feature on the pricing page. Missing for 10: alerting on eval-score drops, PagerDuty as a notification channel, independent or hands-on corroboration of alerting, and detail on threshold/spike configuration.
